contradictions.what: Rep thought the load test had won it, yet Halima responded only 'good' to it and asked for an on-sale plan, which he could have built.
Rep says we were the favourite and the better platform, yet Halima decided in one meeting against us; the favourite claim rests on Ben, not the decider.
Rep relays competitor's on-call promise from Ben as fact, then speculates they over-promised while admitting he doesn't know.
Rep says questions shifted to 'who' after the competitor meeting, but Halima asked 'who's my person' during our own support-plan walkthrough.
